test_title: PYST 59: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** "drag."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Drag"** means to pull something along the ground, often with difficulty or effort. (किसी वस्‍तु को ज़ोर लगाकर घसीटना)
 
• This sentence talks about pulling him down into the doldrums of mediocrity.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

If you surround__ yourself with the good and righteous, they can only __raise__ you up. If you __encircle__ yourself with the others, they will __**drag**__ you down into the doldrums of mediocrity, and they will keep you there, but only as long as you ______ (5) ______ it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Nurture"** means to care for and encourage the growth or development of something. (बढ़ते बच्‍चों या पौधों आदि की देखभाल और रक्षा करना, पालना-पोसना)
 
• **"Foster" **also means to encourage the development of something, but with a focus on providing support and resources. (किसी ग़ैर बच्‍चे को अपनाकर अपने परिवार में पालन-पोषण करना परंतु गोद लेने की क़ानूनी कार्रवाई किए बिना)
 
• **"Elevate"** means to raise something to a higher position or level. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऊँचा उठाना या उच्‍चतर पद पर पहुँचाना)
